input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913), with a glassmorphism HUD. Zero external dependencies, valid JavaScript.
constraints: Single file index.html; all CSS and JS inline; no external URLs, fonts, scripts or images.
Page background and canvas clear color #060913; body margin 0, overflow hidden.
A <canvas id="sim"> fills the full window (position fixed, 100vw x 100vh); on resize set canvas.width/height = innerWidth/innerHeight * devicePixelRatio and ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame; dt is clamped to max 0.05 s.
Central star at canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white core -> #ffd27a -> #ff9a3c -> transparent) plus a corona whose radius pulses subtly with Math.sin(simTime).

Exactly 6 planets in window.app.planets, each object {name, radius (orbit px), speed (rad/s), color, size, angle, trail:[]}; orbital radii distinct (e.g. 70,110,155,205,260,320 scaled by min(w,h)/800), speeds distinct, colors distinct: #8ecae6, #f4a261, #2a9d8f, #e76f51, #b5a8ff, #ffd166.
At least 3 moons total in window.app.moons, each {parent (planet index), radius, speed, angle, size, color}; drawn orbiting their parent planet.
Each planet keeps a trail of its last ~60 positions; trails drawn as fading lines (alpha decreasing toward the oldest point) only when app.trails is true. Faint orbit circles are always drawn.
Background starfield: window.app.stars array of 200 stars {x,y,r,phase,twinkleSpeed}; each star alpha = 0.3 + 0.7*abs(sin(phase + t*twinkleSpeed)) so they twinkle.

window.app object exposes: running (bool, default true), trails (bool, default true), speed (number, default 1), simTime (seconds, number), fps (number), particles (array), planets, moons, stars, reset() function, spawnBurst(x,y) function.
simTime advances by dt*app.speed only while running; planets/moons/particles freeze when paused (stars may keep twinkling).

HUD: a fixed panel id="hud" top-left, glassmorphism: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 14px, padding 14px, color #e6ecff, font system-ui 13px, box-shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4).

HUD buttons: <button id="btnPlay"> text 'Pause' when running and 'Play' when paused; <button id="btnTrails"> text 'Trails: ON' / 'Trails: OFF'; <button id="btnReset"> text 'Reset'. Buttons styled translucent with hover highlight.

HUD slider exactly: <input id="speed" type="range" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0"> with readout <span id="speedVal"> showing e.g. '1.0x', updated on 'input' event and app.speed set to the slider value.
HUD stats: <span id="fps"> (integer FPS, updated about every 0.5 s), <span id="time"> (simTime with 1 decimal followed by ' s'), <span id="count"> (app.particles.length), updated every frame.
Reset: sets simTime=0, restores planet/moon initial angles, clears trails and particles, speed back to 1.0 (slider and readout too), running=true, trails=true, button texts updated.

Clicking the canvas calls app.spawnBurst(clientX, clientY): pushes 60 particles moving radially outward at random speeds 80-260 px/s with random hue, each {x,y,vx,vy,life,maxLife,color}; velocity multiplied by damping (e.g. Math.pow(0.92, dt*60)) each frame, alpha = life/maxLife fading out, particles removed when life <= 0. Draw particles with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' for glow.
Clicks on the HUD must not spawn bursts (listener on the canvas only, HUD above the canvas with z-index).

content.text:
I built `index.html` through Tandem, and it passed all the automated browser checks.

- **Scene:** a glowing central star with a gently pulsing corona, 6 planets on separate orbits with fading trails, 3+ moons, and 200 twinkling background stars on a #060913 background.
- **Controls panel:** a frosted-glass panel in the top-left with Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF and Reset buttons. It also has the speed slider (0.2–3.0) with a live readout, plus live FPS, simulation time and burst particle count.
- **Bursts:** clicking anywhere on the canvas sends out a burst of glowing particles that slow down and fade. Clicks on the panel don't trigger a burst.

The checks confirmed the scene animates and that each button, the slider and the click burst have the right effect. I haven't looked at the page myself, so how it looks is still unchecked. Open `index.html` in a browser to see it.
